svg.title: Inside a Druid segment — columnar storage and indexes
svg.desc: Comparison of row-based vs columnar storage, plus bitmap indexes inside a Druid segment.

g.text: Read all columns even if you need 1
Bitmap index — how Druid filters instantly
One bit per row per value. WHERE city='Delhi' → AND the bitmaps, no row scan needed.

svg.text: Result arrives in milliseconds even across millions of rows
